explanation: From this branch: compare_author_results.mts now appends its R 4.4.1 review sentence to a regenerated output only when the spec was not pinned to the current regenerated bytes; every earlier spec pins a predecessor, so existing generated notes are unchanged. The change is one condition in the comparison builder and touches no repository structure, command, delivery path or startup context. From main: CONTEXT.md's Bundle-writer seam bullet now says the writer takes every track of a study, owns the merged meta.js/qc_global.js/pathways_index and derives arm counts, is3v3 and nSig (one rule: finite PValue < 0.01, matching the QC heading), and names buildIntakeStudies in scripts/lib/intakeStudies.mts as the staged intake pipeline the September 5 builder uses. It records why the fingerprinted HFD and OXT/AVP builders stay byte-identical. Only three studies' qc_global.js nSig values change.
